notes:
Explain IC pins in a box at the mouse, with descriptions for own chips

Short names on the body cannot say everything. Resting on a pin now
shows its full name, input or output, DIP number, value, whether a
wire is on it and what it is for: built-in parts bring their texts,
switches, lamps and ports get a "Pin description" that an own chip
shows at its pin.
